answer: SPHINCS+ is a stateless hash-based signature built from a hypertree of Merkle trees whose leaves are few-time signatures, with a random leaf chosen per message so no state tracking is needed. Signing hashes the message, picks a leaf, and returns the authentication path up to the root public key. The anchor of security is pure hash strength, a crystal-clear chain with no trapdoor, and each signal verifies against the same root. A Sybil farm cannot mint identities cheaply, because every signature needs a real hypertree key pair and forging one needs a hash inversion or collision.
